en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a valley with coal mining facilities, spoil heaps and small settlements, framed on the left by a pine tree. Low, forested hills rise in the background. On the front lower left, handwritten-style text reads "Pécs. Szénbányatelepek." The reverse side is an unused divided postcard back with printed Hungarian text and space for the address.
